The evidence consistently identifies Denali as the highest U.S. point, with supporting details on its elevation and status. Other documents add non‑contradictory facts about the highest peaks in the contiguous states and various measurement perspectives, fitting the complementary‑information label.

The highest point in the United States is Denali in Alaska, with a summit elevation of 20,310 feet (6,190 meters) above sea level [d1,d2,d6,d10]. This is consistently reported across multiple sources [d7,d10]. For the contiguous United States (the lower 48 states), the highest point is Mount Whitney in California [d2,d3,d8,d9].
